summary: All round-1 minors are resolved. Both security-regression tests are genuine: htmlModeEscapesDoubleQuoteInAttribute pins the new case '"'->""" path and verifies that author markup quotes survive unchanged; markdownV2EscapesBackslashToPreventInjection pins the c=='\\' guard with a minimal payload ("\\*") and a precise 4-char expected value confirmed by runtime. markdownV2ModeEscapesFullCharset updated payload includes the leading backslash and the expected assertion is arithmetically correct (7 + 19×2 = 45 chars). Both lone-brace edge-case tests (loneClosingBraceWithoutOpenerIsLiteral, closingBracesAfterPlaceholderLeaveLoneBrace) are behaviorally distinct and would fail if the single-pass scan logic were removed. emptyOrNullValueRendersEmpty now explicitly includes {user.last_name} in the template, directly exercising the null last_name resolution path. The Boolean rationale comment was added. Litmus test applied to all 6 new/changed tests — all pass. No new findings. Test suite remains at 23 methods, all unit-level, all with substantive assertions.
